serverInfo.name: uncodedhub-mcp
serverInfo.title: Uncoded Hub Web Agent MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server card for Uncoded Hub. Allows AI agents and assistants to inspect fixed-price web engineering services, check 7-day sprint cohort availability, calculate delivery milestone timelines, query niche-specific blueprints, verify the 50% Late Means Free guarantee, and initiate scoping consultations.

tools.name: get_services_and_pricing
tools.description: Retrieve Uncoded Hub's fixed-price web design and development tiers, deliverables, and timelines.

tools.name: check_sprint_availability
tools.description: Check current availability for upcoming 7-day development sprint cohorts (limited to two clients per month).

tools.name: calculate_sprint_timeline
tools.description: Calculate exact day-by-day sprint milestones (Kickoff, Design Approval, Code Freeze, Staging Review, Launch) based on a preferred start date.

tools.name: get_niche_blueprints
tools.description: Get detailed feature specs, live demo URLs, and performance benchmarks for Uncoded Hub's 6 target niches.

tools.name: verify_guarantee_terms
tools.description: Retrieve the exact contractual terms of the 50% Late Means Free delivery guarantee and 30-day post-launch warranty.

tools.name: book_scoping_call
tools.description: Get direct calendar scheduling instructions for a 20-minute discovery consultation with founders Deepak and Geetha.

resources.name: Uncoded Hub Services & Pricing Specification
resources.description: Full structured breakdown of all development packages, inclusions, exclusions, and technical deliverables.

resources.name: Contractual Delivery Guarantee Policy
resources.description: Legally binding terms of the 7-day timeline and 50% invoice reduction clause.

resources.name: 6 Specialist Niche Blueprints
resources.description: Target audience architecture, conversion components, and live interactive demo specimens.
